decisions: One persistent native light-DOM submitter and shadow native form preserve actual form defaults and cancellation. SubmitEvent.submitter is the persistent native button.
Canonical TanStack stores own current action data and presentation; Group supplies only compatible appearance defaults.
Loading is soft-disabled and retains existing focus; explicit disabled and native Fieldset disability remove keyboard access.
Copy feedback uses one status region and contains no copied data in events.
Static semantic inputs stay on detached template nodes until connection, so cloned composition preserves ARIA values.
limits: No explicit label-for association to the autonomous action host; content and ARIA provide naming.
Generic author-child replacement passes; generated React wrappers and their reconciliation acceptance remain M22.
Contrast uses actual sRGB canvas-converted computed colors and the configured ripple overlay; this is not a physical wide-gamut or speech-output audit.
Final Split Button/Menu behavior remains M13; Theme Switcher remains M10.
Independent review workers were unavailable at their account limit; this slice uses local review and independent native behavior oracles.

validation.localReview: Action state/form ownership, disabled/loading focus, secret-free completion events, ARIA lifecycle, Group surface integration and bounded motion reviewed; no outstanding action-slice defect found.
